items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Brian, see where I left? We left for her.

ctx.x: I left for her, and I'm gonna sing, and Brian, see where I left? We left for her. New York, I knew where I left for her. New York, all. Some place I left her. We left her. We left her. We want to keep me, so we'll be so in the state. We want to keep me, so we'll be so in the state. We also make a professional piano. One man has left hand like nobody. Yeah. When he was young boy, hmmm. Boy could wiggle her left hand.
How long, you toured with Mamie Smith? Huh? You traveled with Mamie Smith? Yes. And the Pitons? Yes.
